StatusLIVE EXECUTIVE DASHBOARD
PurposeFounder-level command board for working-capital deployment, release priority, supplier-capacity trade-offs, trust-weighted commitments, and scarce-resource sequencing across live commercial and operational matters.
Source ruleUpdate cash forecast, revenue forecast, funding and payables release, credit and release control, trust posture, supplier capacity, concentration risk, quarterly plan, executive risk, and linked deal or shipment records first, then refresh this review.
Founder useDecide which opportunities deserve scarce cash, supplier capacity, release approval, and founder attention before controls are loosened.
Protection ruleThis dashboard governs allocation posture only; approved templates, brand assets, and source-record protections stay unchanged.

Capital Allocation Control PostureLink

Control lensCurrent postureFounder readRequired response
Liquidity permissionDeployable buffer is workable but below comfort target.Capital can move selectively, but not broadly.Keep release decisions inside cash-permitted or cash-contained bands.
Release disciplineFounder-gated releases still carry too much capital weight.Attractive revenue is not enough to justify loose release behavior.Require cash, credit, funding, trust, and source proof before release widening.
Trust-weighted allocationAtlantic Foods remains commercially important but trust-fragile.Trust posture should slow allocation even when upside is real.Keep trust-linked movement under active founder gate until proof improves.
Supplier capacity pressureGarlic slot decisions still compete across committed and upside paths.Supplier reservation should follow commitment quality, not commercial excitement.Prioritize committed and high-confidence matters before weighted upside.

Capital Permission BandsLink

Permission bandConditionFounder postureRequired control action
Capital-permittedCash, release, trust, source, and margin evidence are current and aligned.Approve inside stated limits.Record amount, owner, route, and next review date.
Capital-containedOpportunity is valid but depends on near-term proof or narrow movement.Permit only reversible, bounded action.Require cash, funding, credit, and source evidence before widening.
Capital-watchOpportunity is attractive but still weighted, trust-sensitive, or concentration-heavy.Keep under review without full release.Hold capital until forecast and source proof improves.
Capital-constrainedMovement would pressure buffer, release exposure, or supplier capacity.Protect liquidity and committed work first.Route to scenario response, risk, and founder decisions.
Capital-blockedMovement asks for cash, release, or capacity without proof or while blocked actions remain.Stop movement.Document blocked action and proof trigger.

Escalation and Stop RulesLink

RuleConditionRequired escalationFounder action
Buffer breach stopDeployable cash buffer falls below protected threshold or stress gap expands.Route to cash forecast, capital allocation, and founder decisions.Freeze non-critical releases.
Release proof stopRelease request lacks current cash, credit, trust, or funding proof.Route to control integrity, credit release, and funding review.Block movement until proof lands.
Weighted-upside stopWeighted or stretch revenue asks for capital before commitment quality improves.Route to revenue forecast and quarterly plan.Keep capital deferred.
Concentration stopAllocation increases account, supplier, product, or cash concentration without mitigation.Route to concentration review and risk register.Cap exposure or require diversification proof.
Trust-fragility stopTrust posture weakens or blocked actions remain unresolved.Route to trust posture, exception governance, and founder decisions.Keep allocation narrow or blocked.
